name: Magical☆Antique
original_name: まじかる☆アンティーク
source:
The main character of Magical☆Antique is running an antique shop with Sphie, who is a magician and one of the main heroines of this game.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magical_Antique]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
《Magical☆Antique》的主人公与索菲——一位魔法师，也是本作的女主角之一——一起经营着一家古董店。

[引自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magical_Antique]Wikipedia[/url]]
